description: Defines classes and methods for handling MPEG sections and tables, including validation, data access, and management of MPEG section data structures.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents an MPEG section, providing validation, data access, and CRC checking functionalities.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents an MPEG table composed of multiple sections, managing section addition, validation, and data storage.

methods.name: Section()
methods.description: Default constructor for Section class.

methods.name: Section(const Core::DataElement& data)
methods.description: Constructs a Section object with provided data.

methods.name: Section(const Section& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor for Section.

methods.name: ~Section()
methods.description: Destructor for Section.

methods.name: operator=(const Section& RHS)
methods.description: Assignment operator for Section.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the section data is valid.

methods.name: TableId()
methods.description: Returns the table ID of the section.

methods.name: HasSectionSyntax()
methods.description: Checks if the section has syntax.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the section.

methods.name: Extension()
methods.description: Returns the extension field of the section.

methods.name: Version()
methods.description: Returns the version of the section.

methods.name: IsCurrent()
methods.description: Checks if the section is current.

methods.name: IsNext()
methods.description: Checks if the section is the next one.

methods.name: SectionNumber()
methods.description: Returns the section number.

methods.name: LastSectionNumber()
methods.description: Returns the last section number.

methods.name: Hash()
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the section.

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns the data element of the section.

methods.name: GetNumber<TYPE>(uint16_t offset)
methods.description: Template method to get a number of specified type from data at offset.

methods.name: ValidCRC()
methods.description: Validates the CRC of the section.

methods.name: Table(const Core::ProxyType<Core::DataStore>& data)
methods.description: Constructor for Table, initializes with data.

methods.name: Storage(const Core::ProxyType<Core::DataStore>& data)
methods.description: Stores new data, resets table state.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the table is valid.

methods.name: TableId()
methods.description: Returns the table ID.

methods.name: Extension()
methods.description: Returns the extension of the table.

methods.name: GetNumber<TYPE>(uint16_t offset)
methods.description: Template method to get a number from table data.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Clears the table data.

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns the data element of the table.

methods.name: AddSection(const Section& section)
methods.description: Adds a section to the table if valid, managing internal state.

methods.name: Insert(const Core::DataElement& data, uint16_t allocatedLength, uint16_t offset)
methods.description: Inserts data into the table's data buffer at specified offset, resizing as needed.
